shortDescription: Union Bank Specialist Officer SO Online Form 2026 for ~395 posts. Apply 21 Jul–10 Aug 2026. Last date today. Official site unionbankofindia.co.in.
content:
Union Bank of India has invited online applications for Specialist Officer (SO) recruitment under project 2026-27.

Total vacancies are approximately 395. Online registration started on 21 July 2026 and closes on 10 August 2026.

Highlights

  • Posts: Specialist Officers (including streams such as Wealth Managers and other SO cadres as notified)
  • Apply online only through Union Bank careers / IBPS registration link
  • Read post-wise qualification and experience carefully before applying

Download the official recruitment PDF from the bank website and apply before the last date.
